## Findings

No fatal defect found.

1. **Nonfatal — `thm-normal-form-for-the-word-quotient-model`, Fact `[F1]` and proof steps 1.1, 1.2, 2.1.**  
   `[F1]` states only that an elementary cancellation deletes an adjacent inverse pair. The cited definition additionally says that a word is reduced when no cancellation applies and that free equivalence consists of finite cancellation/insertion sequences ([dependency text](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-alphabet-words-and-reduction.md:31)). The proof nevertheless uses those omitted clauses:

   - Step 1.1 asserts that the empty word is reduced and freely equivalent to itself.
   - Step 1.2 transports an entire free-equivalence sequence through a fixed suffix.
   - Step 2.1 calls the shortened prefix reduced and uses concatenation/transitivity of move sequences.

   The mathematics is correct and the cited dependency contains everything needed, but the explicit Fact does not license all three steps under the stated proof discipline. This is a sub-30-second citation repair, so my assessment is **nonfatal**.

2. **Nonfatal — proof contracts for the four proof-bearing assigned items are not faithful input maps or anchored boundary worksheets.**  
   Concrete discrepancies in [the merged contract](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/freegroups-1-proof-contracts.json:162):

   - For `thm-word-quotient-model-is-a-group`, the contract omits `given` from steps 1.1 and 3.1 and `algebra` from steps 2.1 and 2.2, although those are explicit proof inputs.
   - For `thm-normal-form-for-the-word-quotient-model`, step 1.2 omits `ih`, while steps 1.3 and 3.1 omit `given`.
   - Every checked boundary entry for the four proofs begins with the repeated, non-anchored text `"Statement and proof:"` four times. Some claim cases the proof never explicitly mentions: for example, “For X empty the quotient is the one-element group” ([contract line 213](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/freegroups-1-proof-contracts.json:213)) and “An already reduced word stops immediately” ([contract line 493](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/freegroups-1-proof-contracts.json:493)).

   These boundary claims are mathematically true or covered by the generic arguments, but they are not anchored to actual proof locations as required. The strict contract checker nevertheless reports 29/29 clean, so it does not detect this semantic mismatch. Assessment: **nonfatal contract defect**.

## Items read and accepted

Mathematically, I accept all five assigned items:

- `prop-free-equivalence-is-an-equivalence-and-a-congruence` — checked zero moves, reversal and concatenation of move sequences, insertions as well as deletions, and arbitrary left/right contexts, including empty contexts and \(X=\varnothing\).
- `def-word-quotient-model-of-the-free-group` — the product is representative-independent by the preceding congruence; it does not redefine “free group” or assume the universal property.
- `thm-word-quotient-model-is-a-group` — checked \(X=\varnothing\), \(n=0\), \(n=1\), associativity, both identity equations, and that the inverse reverses order and inverts every letter.
- `lem-formal-letters-act-by-permutations-on-reduced-words` — both branches land in reduced words; both compositions \(\lambda_{a^{-1}}\lambda_a\) and \(\lambda_a\lambda_{a^{-1}}\) are proved; right-to-left composition recovers reduced words; insertion and deletion preserve the permutation. A bounded independent check covered 485 reduced words and 66,356 insertion-invariance cases.
- `thm-normal-form-for-the-word-quotient-model` — checked length \(0\), length \(1\), already-reduced words, empty alphabet, and both existence and uniqueness. Uniqueness evaluates equal permutations at \(\varepsilon\); it does not assume unique representatives or the universal property.

No assigned text invokes computability, reconventions the published abstract definition, or has a title/Statement stronger than its proof. Every direct dependency has `provenance.statement` equal to `literature-derived` or `ai-altered`; none is `ai-generated`.

## Anything I could not verify

None within the assigned disk scope. Every cited dependency Definition or Statement was located and read. External literature URLs were not needed to license or refute any numbered inference.
